newsitem.title: USA: MOTOR RACING-MARTIN TIES NASCAR RECORD WITH 31ST WIN.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-MARTIN TIES NASCAR RECORD WITH 31ST WIN.

text.p: Mark Martin tied the all-time NASCAR Busch Grand National series wins record on Saturday by riding to victory number 31 in the Birmingham Auto Dealers Easycare 500 at Talladega Superspeedway.
The win was the fifth in eight starts this season for Martin in his Ford Thunderbird. His 31 liftime victories tie him with Jack Ingram for the most ever in the Busch series.

Rookie Steve Park battled Martin right down to the finish stripe. Park, driver of the Teresa and Dale Earnhardt-owned Chevrolet Monte Carlo, won his first race last week at Nashville and was being coached in his pursuit of Martin over the final six laps.

"I can't say enough for Steve Park," said Martin. "He really put me through the paces the last few laps there. I knew what he was doing. I was racing Dale, I wasn't racing Steve. He drives well with someone in his ear."
Jeff Green led the rest of the finishers across the stripe with Kyle Petty, Tim Fedewa and rookies Tim Steele and Matt Kenseth following.
Randy LaJoie finished 12th and remained on top of the standings.
The event was the 11th of 30 races on the NASCAR Busch Grand National series. Next is the Busch Grand National 200 on May 10 at New Hampshire International Speedway in Loudon.
